Q: How do I manage word count effectively?

Better word-count management is a precursor to ensuring an assignment is concise, relevant, and well-structured. To do this:

  • Assign word count for each section (10% intro, 20% conclusion, etc.).
  • Avoid redundancy and irrelevant content.
  • Use heading, subheadings, or bullet points for clarity.
  • Summarize instead of quoting.
  • Remain clear on your topic.
  • Delete all needless words during editing.

    •  

    Observe your institution’s tolerance in regard to the word count (usually around ±10%).
